summary: The finding history writes only what changed; bundled applications get their own tasks; disabled service principals are handled like disabled users.

fixes.title: Finding history writes only what changed
fixes.text: A finding that did not change keeps its state, so each run records only new, changed and closed findings.

fixes.title: Bundled applications get their own tasks
fixes.text: A library bundled in several applications is one task per application, named after its install folder, with full paths and the application version.

fixes.title: Disabled service principals handled like disabled users
fixes.text: A disabled service principal no longer counts as a vulnerable asset, even with high privileges.
